site.name: Dot Abyss Wiki
site.description: A fan-made wiki for Dot Abyss (ドットアビス): character data, skills, the Crest system and team building.

home.heroBody: Every character, the Crest system, Force Chain, and how to build a party of ten in Dot Abyss.
home.crestBody: Two crest types, stacking up to {max} times. A character holds only one type at a time, and buffs scale with the stack count.
home.forceChainBody: Spend a Mana Crystal to fire a skill before its gauge fills. That unlocks the additional effect of the skill, which is where crest payoffs live.
home.partyBody: Start from Front {front} / Back {back} and fill the rest with Assist units: they never enter combat but boost the party in proportion to their own Assist stats.
home.elementBody: Enemies have a weakness element and take more damage from it. Your characters have no weakness element, so enemy elements never raise incoming damage. A healer heals more when the target shares its element.

character.noDetailBody: Only roster-level data is recorded for this character. Skills and passives are being added batch by batch.
character.awakeningNote: SSR units have 2 passive slots, SR and R have 1. Awakening effects are unlocked by Limit Break with duplicates and exist only on SSR.
character.statsBasis: At Lv30 with 5 limit breaks, before ability and facility bonuses.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.subtitle: {gear} weapons and gear · {crystals} mana crystals
equipment.partyUniqueNote: The effect activates for only one copy per party; a second has no extra effect.
equipment.crystalNote: An additional effect needs an ally in the chain holding its crest at level 5 or higher, and scales with the number of qualifying participants.
equipment.noStats: The source page publishes no stat values or rarity tiers for equipment, so neither is recorded here.

team.title: Team builder
team.subtitle: Up to {size} units on the field. Start from Front {front} / Back {back}.
team.emptyTeam: Nothing picked yet. Choose a character on the left to add them.
team.shareHint: The link carries the team in its URL, so it can be shared as-is. No account needed.
team.noDominantCrest: The crests are split evenly, so crest-targeted effects reach only half the team.
team.noticeOverCapacity: The team has {size} units, over the maximum of {max}.
team.noticeFrontShort: Only {count} Front units, below the recommended {recommended}. The back line will be exposed.
team.noticeBackShort: Only {count} Back units, below the recommended {recommended}. Damage and healing will fall short.
team.noticeNoAssist: No Assist unit. The party is giving up the stat bonus Assist units grant for free.
team.noticeCrestMinority: {count} unit(s) hold Crest: {minority} while the team leans {dominant}. They gain nothing from effects that target {dominant}.
team.limitsBody: Healer checks now work from weapon class. Only Kururu is still unknown, because two wikis disagree about her. The Assist bonus cannot be calculated: the game derives it from the summed Assist stats of your own units, which depend on your levels and gear.
team.noticeNoHealer: No healer. Nobody on the team carries a Grimoire, the only weapon class that restores ally HP.
team.noticeHealerUnknown: Cannot tell whether the team has a healer: {count} member(s) have no weapon class recorded.
team.noticeHealerElement: {healers} healer(s), element {element}. {count} ally/allies share that element and will be healed for more.
team.presetNote: These rosters are recorded from {credit} as starting points to adapt. Every word of explanation on this page is written here, not copied from the source.

presets.free-to-play: Free to play, SR and R only

presetNotes.collapse-passion: All seven combat units (1 Front, 6 Back) hold Crest: Passion, so every one of them qualifies to join a chain on the Passion Mana Crystal [Collapse], which deepens the enemy Defense DOWN by a further 7.5% per qualifying participant. Two Grimoire healers cover the line between them by element: Myrtille (Earth) heals Henrietta and Magnolia for more, Lycorit (Fire) does the same for Wisteria, Awakened Verisa and Rusita. The fragile part is the single Front unit: Henrietta holds the line alone.
presetNotes.collapse-no-lux-nova: The same idea for players without Lux Nova units, dropping Myrtille and Pico. The cost is the Earth healer: only Lycorit (Fire) remains, so Henrietta and Magnolia no longer get the same-element healing bonus. Christie, who replaces Myrtille, holds Crest: Impact and cannot join a Passion chain, leaving six qualifying units instead of seven.
presetNotes.void-poison-impact: The mirror image in Impact: all six Back units hold Crest: Impact, feeding chains on Impact Mana Crystal [Void] and [Poison], both Back-slot crystals that need an ally holding Impact at level 5 or higher. Henrietta is still the only wall despite holding the opposite crest, because her job is absorbing damage rather than joining the chain. Frederica is the healer, and her Dark element matches Christie and Liella.
presetNotes.gale-front: Inverted to Front 6 / Back 1 to push the Impact Mana Crystal [Gale], the Impact crystal in the Front slot. Naia, Scarlet, Film and Chihiro hold Impact, exactly filling the chain cap of 4 that Gale allows. Carla and Orelina add bodies but hold Passion, so they cannot join it. The numbers expose one risk: the only healer is Lycorit, and nobody in the combat line shares her Fire element, so nothing gets the same-element healing bonus even though six Front units are absorbing hits.
presetNotes.free-to-play: No SSR at all: seven SR and three R. At Front 3 / Back 4 it sits closest to the recommended baseline of the five teams here. The crests split 6 Passion / 4 Impact, which is the natural limit of a team built without pulls. Noemi (Earth) is the healer and shares her element with Shannon. Worth noting: Himari is only SR but her base line of 3168 / 1640 / 952 stands with several SSR units.
